verdict.rationale: Jitsu Functions process events before they reach destinations, with explicit Filter, Transform and Enrich modes written in JavaScript/TypeScript. Functions also get Fetch API for third-party enrichment, persistent storage, logging to Live Events and a warehouse query API. Custom code is supported by an in-UI debugger that runs functions on sample data and a CLI workflow that scaffolds a tested TypeScript project and deploys it. A 2021 HN comment saying functions 'don't seem present' is an early, tentative observation rather than a hands-on failure, so it lowers confidence slightly but is no concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that Functions work as documented in production.
